about.metaDescription: What AMIGOS Database is, how the co-op catalog works, and where the data comes from.
about.title: About
about.lead: A catalog for groups picking their next co-op game without wading through generic store lists.
about.whatBody: A static site with cooperative game write-ups: player counts, session length, difficulty, tags, and short editorial notes. It is meant to help the group decide—not replace specialist reviews or store pages.
about.includesCatalog: Filterable catalog with shareable URLs and a random picker
about.includesBrowser: Web Arcade — browser games grouped by category
about.includesDeals: Best price via CheapShark, shown in BRL in the UI
about.includesGameplay: Gameplay video on game pages when the YouTube API key is set
about.ratingsBody: Each game has an overall score and, on most pages, a five-axis radar: communication, skill, chaos, strategy, and story. These are relative within the catalog—a quick read on session vibe, not a final verdict.
about.techStack: React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Zustand, TanStack Query, and i18next. Shipped as a static SPA.
about.sourcesBody: Prices: CheapShark. Art: Steam CDN when a store link exists. Video: YouTube Data API. Editorial content is in Portuguese; other UI languages fall back to PT on game pages.

categoryDescriptions.survival: Face hostile environments together. Gather resources, craft supplies, and deal with constant threats.
categoryDescriptions.roguelike: Every run is different with permanent death and gradual progression. No two sessions are alike.
categoryDescriptions.puzzle: Cooperative mental challenges. Team communication and logical thinking are key to success.
categoryDescriptions.simulation: Manage complex systems as a team. Expect organized chaos and plenty of laughs.
categoryDescriptions.party: Casual fun for bigger groups. Easy to learn and surprisingly competitive.
categoryDescriptions.coop_campaign: Play through epic stories together. Character progression, narrative choices, and memorable moments.
categoryDescriptions.tactical_action: Military-style coordination. Every decision matters and mistakes have consequences.
